execution_steps: 1. Mount persistent state directory (/icarus/memory) and harness scripts into container filesystem.
2. Inject runtime environment keys (GITHUB_TOKEN, GEMINI_API_KEY, COMPOSIO_API_KEY) into container context.
3. Initialize icarus_daemon.py loop linked to harness-runner-v2.py for task execution and tool invocation.
4. Enable Composio API gateway and GitHub writeback handlers inside the execution sandbox.
5. Run verify_icarus_pulse.py to validate container readiness, tool connectivity, and ledger synchronization.

requested_user_endpoint: Submit a task through the local Fixer Web UI.
Load identity.md and current-state.md from Icarus memory and reason using the chosen model.
Execute requested GitHub and Composio tool actions.
Stream the response back to the Web UI and record a receipt.
